title: MPX EncounterPlus V5 Group
description: Source definition of a group in an EncounterPlus V5 module project.

slug.markdownDescription: *Required.* Stable text identifier without accents or spaces. Separate words with hyphens. Each content item in the module must use a different slug.
slug.patternErrorMessage: The slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (no spaces, accents, or uppercase).

rank.markdownDescription: *Required.* Numeric order among contents sharing the same parent.

parent.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Slug of the parent page or group. Leave empty to place the group at the module root.
